purpose: Teach: 池上/浅井/塩野/大村/亀山/成瀬/中沢/川村

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、池上氏と共同事業を立ち上げられた
lines.en: When you were younger, you started that joint venture with Ikegami, didn't you.
lines.style: Gentle, almost reminiscing. Warm recognition of a shared past. Measured pace, letting each name settle. The tone of an elder calling up something precious and well-kept.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは浅井先輩のご薫陶を受けられた
lines.en: Yes. Father learned so much from Senior Asai's guidance.
lines.style: Respectful, honoring the lineage. Quiet conviction on the names. Not rehearsed—lived experience coming through. A son speaking about his father with steady warmth.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、塩野氏と海外進出を企画された
lines.en: And with Shiono, you planned that overseas expansion back then.
lines.style: Same gentle rhythm as before. A soft note of wistfulness—looking back at ambitions that were real, that mattered. Pace unhurried, inviting him to remember.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは大村氏を広報の柱に据えられた
lines.en: Yes. Father made Omura the cornerstone of our public relations.
lines.style: Speaking with quiet certainty about the structure of those choices. A slight pause before each name, honoring the decision. The calm clarity of someone reflecting on what was built.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、亀山氏と経理体制を整えられた
lines.en: And Kameyama—you both put the accounting systems in order when you were young.
lines.style: The same measured cadence. A breath of appreciation before each name, as if handling something carefully. Wistful but not sad—the tone of someone savoring the architecture of a life's work.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは成瀬氏を主任として育てられた
lines.en: Yes. Father developed Naruse as a lead person, nurtured her through it.
lines.style: Speaking with quiet pride in the choice. Each name held with care. The reflection of someone who watched people grow under good leadership, now seeing that legacy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、中沢氏と海外法人を立ち上げられた
lines.en: And Nakasawa—together you established that overseas subsidiary.
lines.style: The same gentle persistence in the rhythm. A note of completion here, wrapping an arc. Still wistful, but with the satisfaction of something accomplished and well-remembered.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは川村氏に法務全般を委ねられた
lines.en: Yes. Father entrusted Kawamura with everything on the legal side.
lines.style: Closing with steady wisdom. A calm, final note of respect for the choices made and the people trusted. Not summing up—just acknowledging the truth of it, cleanly and with weight.
